batches.title: Unknown stays unknown
batches.what: Stop turning missing stats, unread clubs and unknown lists into zeros or green verdicts; fix the bench read that counts a lone catcher as his own backup.

batches.title: No developer or code text on screen
batches.what: Give calibration stamps a GM-facing line separate from their provenance; never interpolate level ids, column names or enum values into served text.

batches.title: One number and count formatter
batches.what: A single shared helper for counts, plurals, thousands, minus signs, dashes and innings (x.1/x.2), replacing the ~18 local copies.

batches.title: Stores follow the save and never strand a view
batches.what: Every store resets on a save or club switch; the in-flight guard survives cancellation; errors clear on a good answer; page state survives navigation; inputs say why they were refused.

batches.title: Sidebar and Mac behaviours
batches.what: Clickable, keyboard-reachable sidebar headers without the per-click rebuild; farm rows publish the focused player; palette, menu bar, badges and drag and drop behave like a Mac app; trim per-render work.

batches.title: Settings, Setup and the transaction-log fix
batches.what: Data Status and every log-missing line point to the fix; a set AI key looks set; Settings exposes its choices and state; Setup counts clubs the way the club list does and explains exports.

batches.title: Decision pages
batches.what: Dedupe the comparison, name the player in farm findings, compose each reason once, condition sentences on what's actually present, and make the clubhouse pages agree on position and grade.

batches.title: Facts agree across pages
batches.what: One freshness and byline source; one payroll-room definition; one staff role vocabulary and a human-GM check; a current "later version" list; correct club links; trade validity; server-side draft sorting; the wire's injury.

batches.title: Tables, heads and layout
batches.what: Per-column widths and full-text hovers in the shared tables; heads that wrap instead of truncating; roster-map z-order; empty-state cards; narrow and inspector layouts; charts; CI captures for the missing views.

batches.title: Words, after the phrasebook
batches.what: Percentiles instead of "on the 0–100 scale", no department names as speakers, one caveat instead of one per row, consistent titles, no "the" before club names, and copy moved out of Swift.

items.title: Hover notes show developer details and a developer's local save
items.sees: Value and roster-map hovers read "fitted by production-3b.1 (playerValueProductionFit.ts) ... a developer's local save (its league id) ... npm run calibrate ... (D-053)", 20 times per club report; Org Comparison and the farm's lines table show "provisional ratings prior", "(a developer's local save, its export date)", "(Q-3)".

Other stamps with the same provenance: resultsMetrics.ts, toolsModel.ts, roleStandards.ts, roleReview.ts, mlbCalibrationFit.ts, mlbResultsFit.ts, mlbToolsFit.ts, mlbPlatoonFit.ts.

items.title: Settings hides choices and state
items.sees: No provider, model, AI features, auto-import or rounding choices; Updates has no Check Now, version or reason; notifications may never ask permission and show "on" when denied; the Transaction log field has no label; Appearance has a single-choice radio group.
items.cause: PF/Shell/SettingsView.swift:670-706, :883-889, :194-221; server/presentation/ai/keys.ts:48, :79; PF/Shell/UpdatesSettings.swift:16-39; macos/Pennant/OutsideTheWindow.swift:37-39, :62-88 (no notification delegate).

items.title: Sidebar badges, the menu bar and the widget
items.sees: Sidebar badges show while the club question is open (the Dock badge hides); menu bar items can't be clicked and there's no refresh; the widget may tick "Updated 2 hours, 5 minutes ago".
items.cause: PF/FeatureCore/DepartmentModule.swift:64-68 (no clubOwed guard, unlike macos/Pennant/OutsideTheWindow.swift:55); PF/Shell/MenuBarGlanceView.swift:26, :119-126; macos/PennantWidgets/GlanceWidgetView.swift:103-104.

items.title: Quick Open can open the wrong thing
items.sees: ⌘K's highlight can jump when late results arrive, so Return opens a different entry; only 12 results with no scroll; two different search fields; five views all called "Report".
items.cause: PD/CommandPalette.swift:29, :45, :51, :161; PF/Shell/MainWindowView.swift:92-112; server/presentation/searchWords.ts:48-84; server/presentation/catalog.ts:148-169.

items.title: Charts look broken or unexplained
items.sees: Franchise History's single unknown season draws as a huge hollow block; the payroll "could be" bars have no legend; the value chart ignores the club colours and its pending band covers known seasons; Season Trends shows .500 as "50%".
items.cause: PF/League/LeagueOfficeViews.swift:279-291; PF/Finance/PayrollView.swift:191; PF/Player/PlayerValueTab.swift:138-180; Season Trends payload charts[2].

items.title: Compare and History tables push content off-screen
items.sees: A long value widens Compare's column and pushes the second player out of view; History's 13 fixed columns overflow, with W-L as "—-—" and teams as "C1"/"F1".
items.cause: PF/Player/CompareWindowView.swift:165 (two-way ScrollView, text never wraps); server/presentation/player/dossier.ts:978, :1088; server/player.ts:207 (t.abbr).

items.title: Heavy work on every redraw
items.sees: The Morning Report rebuilds its whole design from a ~100 KB payload twice per redraw; Player Search and the Draft Board re-join, re-sort and re-search all rows on every keystroke (unprofiled; may explain the CI stalls).
items.cause: PF/FrontOffice/MorningReportView.swift:173, :311 with MorningReportDesign.swift:99-103; PK/ScoutingStore.swift:108-112; PF/FeatureCore/OfficeKit.swift:503-511, :766-768.

items.title: The Morning Report puts "To decide" last on ordinary windows
items.sees: Below ~1,360-pt windows the desk comes after the map, staff and the league, one frame late; the Whole Desk button exists only here; "The rest" heads every row in a small league.
items.cause: PF/FrontOffice/MorningReportView.swift:95-106, :301-324, :367, :377.

items.title: The philosophy summary contradicts itself when nothing is set
items.sees: With every setting at 50 it says both "broadly balanced, without a strongly expressed lean" and "so this is a focused philosophy".
items.cause: server/presentation/philosophy/identity.ts:156, :186-193 (no branch for zero expressed settings).

items.title: The payroll budget box silently throws away what you type
items.sees: "150M", "$150", "150,000,000" or "150,5" revert to the old value with no message; Return then losing focus may save twice.
items.cause: PF/Finance/PayrollView.swift:312, :329-346 (Double() parse, silent revert).

items.title: The GM's question disappears while the trade desk thinks
items.sees: The draft is cleared on send and the question appears only when the answer arrives.
items.cause: PF/Trades/TradeDeskView.swift:211-217; PK/TradesStore.swift:249.

items.title: Wire injury lines name no injury
items.sees: "P 1053 was hurt" with the basis "Length, as the export records it: 12" and no unit.
items.cause: server/leagueWire.ts:320 reads only length and day_to_day (body_part and effect unused); server/presentation/frontOffice/wire.ts:108, :147.

items.title: Titles, labels and column heads are inconsistent
items.sees: "Position players" beside "Pitching Availability"; "Also worth a look (1)"; cryptic heads (T, P/3d, HLD, Brl%); "Coming in less going out"; "−<0.1 wins"; Every Contract keeps the payroll lede.
items.cause: server/presentation/majorLeague/views.ts:69, :283, :401, :443; PF/Finance/PayrollView.swift:38; trades payloads.

items.title: "the Club 1 N" and "him" for everyone
items.sees: "Ask him about the Club 1 N" (for Ana Frey too), "Meetings with the Club 4 N", "The Club 1 N's philosophy".
items.cause: server/presentation/ai/staffRoom.ts:82; server/presentation/league/usVsThem.ts:193-200; server/presentation/player/dossier.ts:713.

items.title: Some words and numbers are written in the app instead of served
items.sees: "N of M", "$", "million", "Weighing", "Available now (N)" and the depth plate's top-3 limit live in Swift.
items.cause: PF/Finance/ContractsView.swift:53; PF/Finance/PayrollView.swift:305, :314; PF/MajorLeague/DepthChartView.swift:180 vs server/presentation/clubhouse/depth.ts:16.

items.title: Drag and drop and "Open in New Window" fall short
items.sees: Dropping a player into Notes or Mail gives nothing; clubs can't be dropped on Compare; "Open in New Window" brings the existing window forward; Compare chips start blank with a stray focus ring.
items.cause: PK/Routing.swift:53-88 (private UTTypes only); PF/Player/CompareWindowView.swift:54; PF/FeatureCore/Attention.swift:256.

items.title: Small layout slips
items.sees: A Game Plan row with a missing cell shifts later cells into the wrong columns; a red "What-if" badge plus a "Scenario" badge; ratings bars 2 pt out of line; separate copies of the Office head with different spacing.
items.cause: PF/MajorLeague/ScheduleView.swift:147-157; PF/Player/PlayerRatingsTab.swift:63; Coaching Staff / Trades heads.

items.title: No automated check captures the Front Office report or a narrow Morning Report
items.sees: CI's Front Office screenshot shows the GM Briefing, so layout slips there go unseen.
items.cause: macos UI tests (department-frontOffice.png capture).
